notes:
Summary: LintLane builds an IDE+web-based PR assistant for mid-sized engineering orgs. Primary KPI = reviewer time saved (target 30-40%).

What they want: lightweight PR bot that can summarize diffs, propose suggested comments, and produce reranked list of the top 3 suggested reviewers/suggestions. Need deterministic outputs for audit trails and the ability to pin model versions per-repo.

Latency/throughput constraints: engineers stressed streaming token-by-token in the IDE; target p95 end-to-end latency for single-file PRs (200-400 tokens) <= 120ms, peak throughput ~50 req/s for CI hook. Cost sensitivity: want to understand per-comment token economics.

Security & deployment: must run in VPC for customer repos; SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for admin console; KMS for key management; retention controls and per-customer residency (EU customers).

POC scope: 4-week POC — integrate with 2 test repos, 1-week training on prompt sets, 2 weeks live testing with real PRs (canary), final week: metrics and runbook for scaling. Success criteria: median reviewer time reduction >=25%, p95 latency <120ms, reproducible suggestions across runs.

Quotes: "If you can hit streaming latencies and give us model pinning, we can replace 70% of manual review comments." — Head of Engineering.

Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_3b2a9c_pr-kickoff-2026-03-02; gmail thread-CA+-20260304_poc-questions; drive pricing/security links above.

Concerns: legal will push on EU residency; CTO wants sandbox benchmark showing latency under load. Budget timeline: talk with finance in mid-March.

Next steps: schedule POC kickoff (Arjun to send SOW), provide dedicated latency benchmark harness, provide draft model-pinning SLA and audit log sample.
